inputs: A URL and public metadata captured outside this package, as an IngestionEnvelope
A batch objective, a BatchBudget and the stop conditions agreed before collecting
A researcher's screening signals, confidence and rights judgement
invariants: No network, scraper, downloader, browser or model in either direction: metadata arrives captured, nothing here imports production, and no production module imports this.
Every number about the outside world is a Measurement with mandatory Evidence, and a rate whose denominator was never observed is absent rather than zero.
Private channel analytics - retention, revenue, RPM, traffic sources - are refused by name on any payload key.
A URL is canonicalized or rejected, never guessed; identity is platform + external id, never a title.
A local copy requires a named authoriser; the ingestion path can produce neither.
Only a screened-in candidate promotes to a ResearchSource, and a person signs every screening decision.
A batch declares its budget and stop conditions before collecting; a breached ceiling stops it or is escalated by a named authoriser, never silently continued.
Research confidence may never be permanent, and every finding names what would overturn it.
outputs: DiscoveryCandidate, deduplicated on platform + external id, with every query that found it
SnapshotSeries: dated public readings, appended, plus derived rates the inputs support
ResearchBatch: an append-only round log, budget consumption and the stop conditions triggered
BatchReport: duplication, creator concentration, tag coverage, saturation components, funnel counts and cost per useful outcome
ScoreResult carrying weight coverage and a caveat it cannot travel without
purpose: Stores and evaluates external research: a discovery queue that deduplicates public video metadata cheaply, a batch layer that budgets and measures a search, and the six record types a reviewed opportunity is built from.
risks: Public metrics are a moving surface: a snapshot is an observation of a day, never a property of a video.
Deduplication is only as strong as the platform id; a platform without one falls back to the canonical URL.
The funnel describes tiers 3-5 but executes none of them - stopping early is a person's decision, not a default.
Saturation is measured over rounds a researcher recorded; a round nobody logged is invisible to every rate.
title: Research intelligence
